parent_objective: audit M1585 public-pass evidence-quality-fail source-diverse intervention result
blocked_by: M1585 public gates passed but evidence-quality targets failed as control_dominated

public_gates: M1586 must audit M1585 public pass and evidence-quality failure
M1586 must separate live source-diverse intervention plumbing from history-necessity evidence
M1586 must explain control dominance and high-speed endpoint absence
M1586 must choose next route before any implementation, materialization, or training
M1586 must keep materialization training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits public-pass control-dominated source-diverse intervention result
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: audit only; no simulator rerun, history interventions, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit treats M1585 as history-necessity evidence
stop if audit ignores zero-action/current-frame control dominance
stop if audit treats high-speed endpoint absence as solved
stop if audit routes directly to materialization, training, PPO, promotion, or private holdout
fallback_plan: admit stricter history-vs-control active-set design if diagnostics justify it
admit source repair if endpoint absence is the main blocker
route to branch synthesis if the pairability branch is overfitting public rows
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1585 completed bounded public intervention smoke and requires audit

allowed_updates: M1586 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if audit admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1585 included current-frame controls and they dominated, so audit must not strengthen the claim.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If control dominance remains the blocker, record it and route to stricter active-set or synthesis instead of weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1585's public-pass control-dominated result can be audited into a defensible next route without overstating history evidence.
success_criteria: audit summarizes M1585 public and evidence-quality results
audit separates live harness evidence from history-necessity evidence
audit discusses zero-action/current-frame control dominance and high-speed endpoint absence
training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export materialization and self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit treats M1585 as level3 self-ID evidence
audit ignores control dominance or high-speed caveat
audit routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export actor-input changes or candidate materialization

result.audit_conclusion: intervention plumbing and broad history effects are live, but evidence is too control-dominated for history necessity; next route must select or generate history-vs-control active-set rows

decision_rule: M1586 passes if it audits M1585 and chooses the next route before any repair, materialization, or training.
